page.overview:
Who is Alien Trooper?

Alien Trooper is an Alien Conquest minifigure that was introduced in 2011.

The Alien Troopers have black legs, printed with medium lilac padding. Their torsos are also black, and are printed with a large silver device (possibly a life-support unit), and more padding. They have purple arms, and Lime Green hands. Their Lime Green heads are uniquely molded, and show a large toothy mouth, big black eyes, and the upper area of an exposed brain.

The Alien Troopers are the bulk of the alien army, and primarily fight on land, although they are sometimes seen piloting vehicles.

"Hey, you! Yeah, you! You look like you got a pretty big brain, huh? Lots of thinking going on in there. Us Alien Troopers, we don’t gotta do a lot of thinking. But we’re really good at taking orders and shouting and smashing stuff. Oh, and shooting our lasers! Pyew, pyew! Like that! Sometimes it’s hard to remember which end of the laser to point away from us. That’s why our brains are no good for powering flying saucers. So we came to Earth to get yours! Now hand over all of your brains, or, uh…or else!”
